name: blueprint/parallel-cleanup
description: Fan-out cleanup of recent changes: split into independent pieces, clean each in parallel, gate the combined diff, receipts per piece
ingredients: harness workflow fan-out (the agent plans the split)
recipe: split the recent changes into independent pieces -> fan out the cleanup, one piece per lane -> receipt per piece -> gate the combined diff before it ships
pitfalls: overlapping edits conflict - independence is the split's contract
one receipt per piece keeps lanes auditable
the gate reviews the diff (delegate-cli-coder learnings)
